notes.Options_Vsync: VSync is the approved Dutch technical setting name.
notes.PondQuery_StatusRequestOneCount: PondQueryMenu uses this only when neededItemCount <= 1 and the non-English article is empty. Numeric 1 combines with the manually authored quantity×item format, preserving the exact item count without requiring English-only plural inflection.
